title: What the exam usually looks like
intro: Short written questions, each worth 2 or 3 marks, where most marks go to **showing the rule you used**.
scope: Units 1 and 2: events, the axioms, the complement and addition rules, counting, conditional probability, independence, trees and Bayes' rule.

blocks.p: Two questions, one per unit, each split into short parts. Practice paper 1 has this shape.
Almost every paper. Know it both ways round.

blocks.p: Use the product test, and say in words what it shows.
